description: This file contains validation utility functions for input validation rules such as required fields, character length constraints, range validation, format validation (email, phone), and character restrictions, likely used across a web application.

methods.name: required
methods.description: Validates that the input value is non-empty, non-null, and for arrays/objects, not empty or null.

methods.name: shouldNotExceedCharLength
methods.description: Returns a validator function that checks if a string's length does not exceed a specified maximum.

methods.name: validRange
methods.description: Returns a validator function to check if a numeric string falls within a specified port range.

methods.name: digitsOnly
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only digits, or is empty.

methods.name: validEmailFormat
methods.description: Validates if a string matches a standard email format.

methods.name: validPhoneNumberFormat
methods.description: Validates if a string contains only numbers and allowed phone number characters (+ - / ( ) ).

methods.name: shouldNotLessThanCharLength
methods.description: Returns a validator that enforces a minimum string length.

methods.name: shouldNotContainSpecialChars
methods.description: Returns a validator that checks if a string contains only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

ctags.name: digitsOnly
ctags.pattern: /^export const digitsOnly = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.name: validEmailFormat
ctags.pattern: /^export const validEmailFormat = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/
